headlines.snippet: The White House stated that no negotiations are currently underway with Iran. The press secretary indicated this would continue until the president felt a meaningful approach was being made.

headlines.snippet: Convicted war criminal Ratko Mladic, known as the "Butcher of Bosnia," has died in prison at the age of 84. He was convicted for his role in atrocities during the Bosnian War.

headlines.snippet: New bribery allegations have surfaced in the trial of former Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Mayor Ekrem Imamoğlu. The case could result in a lengthy prison sentence.
